entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I, uh, I need to make a return. I just feel so disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. Could I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
Yes, it's Sarah Jenkins, order number VF881-09. I've been a VeloFit customer for years, I always love your gear, but this time... it's just not right.

Thank you, Sarah. I see your order for the VeloPro road cycling shoes. I'm sorry they didn't meet your expectations. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference or fit issue?

It's the fit. I took them out for one ride, and I came back with terrible blisters on my heels. I tried adjusting the cleats and everything, but the shoes just dig in. I can't wear them again, and I really needed this money for some other things coming up.
Oh, that sounds incredibly painful. Getting blisters is the last thing you want on a ride. I completely understand why you can't use them. Let me check the return eligibility for you.
Okay, I see you received them just 9 days ago. The good news is that our cycling shoes have a 90-day return policy. We can absolutely get you a full refund. No problem at all.
Oh, really? I was so worried it would be a problem. That's... that's a huge relief. Thank you.

Of course. And Sarah, I see here that you're a VIP member with us. We sincerely value your loyalty, and I'm very sorry for the trouble these shoes and the blisters have caused you. To make things right, I'd like to add a $20 store credit to your account for a future purchase and also offer complimentary expedited shipping on your next order.
Wow. You don't have to do that, but... thank you, David. That is so kind. That makes me feel much better about this whole thing. I'd really appreciate that.

It's my pleasure. I've just applied that credit to your account, and you'll receive an email shortly with a pre-paid return label. Just pack the shoes back in their box, attach the label, and drop it off. Once we receive it, your refund will be processed immediately.
That's perfect. You've been a great help. Thanks again, David.
You're very welcome, Sarah. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Have a good day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and happy cycling.
